item.title: NBA 2026 Highlights: Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid combine for 77 in 76ers' win
item.description: The 76ers found themselves in a tight spot against the visiting Kings, trading leads late, but Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid willed their squad to a gritty home victory and combined to score 77 points in Philly.

item.title: NBA 2026 Highlights: Dillon Brooks scores career-high 40 points vs. Pistons
item.description: The injured Suns faced a tall task hosting the Pistons while without Devin Booker, but Dillon Brooks stepped up in a big way with a career-high 40 points.

item.title: NBA 2026 Highlights: Cooper Flagg goes off for 49 points in Mavericks' loss
item.description: Despite being on the wrong end of two-point game loss to the Hornets, Cooper Flagg put on a show for the Dallas crowd and scored an eye-popping 49 points in the 13th-highest-scoring rookie outing in NBA history.

item.title: Rookie showcase game: Cooper Flagg scores 49, Kon Knueppel 34 in Hornets win
item.description: Flagg's 49 points are the most ever by a teenager in the NBA, but his former Duke roommate got the win.
